title: A typed person
hints: An object type lists each property and its type between `{ }`, separated by `;`.
`type Person = { name: string; age: number };` — then read properties with `person.name`. For `haveBirthday`, return a brand-new object literal.
describe: return `${person.name} is ${person.age} years old`;  haveBirthday: return { name: person.name, age: person.age + 1 };
